d:
Suprim kort ne OBC krimi leyar tay karne men mata-pita ki Salary ko akele aadhar manne se inkar kiya hai. kort ne spasht kiya ki iske lie mata-pita ke pad aur uski shreni ko bhi dhyan men rakhna jaruri hai. sath hi, 11 march ke phaisle ke lagu hone aur naee bhartiyon par iske asar ko lekar bhi sthiti saph ki hai.
